abstract: Accurate core-temperature estimation is critical for thermal management of large-format <mark>lithium</mark> iron phosphate (LFP) batteries, yet direct internal sensing is impractical in field-deployed battery management systems. This study presents GAT-TE, a graph-attention-based spatiotemporal estimator that infers the geometric-center core temperature of 230 Ah LFP prismatic cells from externally measurable voltage, current, ambient-temperature, and six surface-temperature measurements.
